title.full: Using employer cover with MediShield Life

summary.text: Yes. Employer cover pays first. MediShield Life pays next for the part not covered, subject to its limits.

details.heading: Who pays first
details.body: Your employer, private insurance, or another third party pays first. MediShield Life or an Integrated Shield Plan pays next.

details.heading: What MediShield Life pays
details.body: MediShield Life pays the part of the bill not covered by your employer, private insurance, or other third-party payers. Claim limits, deductible and co-insurance apply.

example_phrasings: I am covered by Employer Medical Benefits. Can I claim from MediShield Life as well? Who pays first?
Can I use MediShield Life if my employer covers me?
Does my employer or MediShield Life pay first?

MSHL/IP will pay for the portion of the bill that is not covered by employer, private insurance and other third-party payers, subject to claim limits, deductible and co-insurance.
